title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil drafter or junior civil designer (Melbourne)
content_text: No advertised junior vacancy. UDEC careers page (read 5 Oct 2026): open vacancies are Senior Drafter and Senior Designer (8+ years), skipped. Page states: "Don't see a role that fits? We're always keen to hear from talented people. Email your details to recruitment@udec.com.au and we'll be in touch when something suitable comes up." It also says UDEC is currently only taking applications via its contact email. Homepage: UDEC specialises in utility services encompassing gas, electricity, water and sewage relocations, plus design, engineering and construction, with over 20 years of engineering services; Victoria office Unit 18A, 75 Lorimer Street, Docklands; Queensland office Shailer Park.
apply_instructions: Speculative enquiry by email to recruitment@udec.com.au (employer-published inbox inviting CVs when no listed role fits).
